title: BBCI Guwahati Jobs 2026 - Apply Online for 04 Consultant D, Technician C Posts
description: The Dr. B Borroah Cancer Institute (BBCI Guwahati) has officially released the notification to fill the vacancies of 04 Consultant D / Senior Resident and Technician C Jobs. Interested and eligible candidates can use this opportunity to apply for these posts before the last date of application. Candidates who have completed their MD/MS, DNB, Post-graduation, 12th, Diploma, and DMLT can apply for the BBCI Guwahati Jobs 2026. The interested applicants can apply in online mode.
